reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis lacks a physically sound mechanism: adding 10 wt% of unspecified HEA particles to W-Cu would almost certainly decrease thermal conductivity due to interfacial scattering and lower-conductivity inclusions, and sintering at 300°C is far too low to densify W-Cu.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is vague (no specific HEA, no sintering details, no irradiation test) and the falsification criterion is logically flawed because it requires both no increase in conductivity AND degradation of mechanical properties to falsify.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a physically implausible mechanism and an impractical processing condition, offering no credible path for a researcher to follow.
